newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Retevision Q1 net profit up 40 percent.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Retevision Q1 net profit up 40 percent.

text.p: Retevision, which will soon become Spain's second basic telephone operator, said on Tuesday it ended the first quarter of 1997 with net profit of 1.16 billion pesetas, up 40 percent versus the year-ago period.
The statement added that cash flow climbed 27 percent to four billion pesetas in the same period.
Turnover rose seven percent to 9.49 billion pesetas.
At the end of April Retevision said three bids had been accepted for the state's sale of 60 percent of what will be Spain's second telephone service provider.
